data.name: Gyanada
data.gender_notes: Gyanada is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Gyanada is a Sanskrit name derived from the word gyana, meaning knowledge or wisdom. In Hindu mythology, this name is associated with goddess Saraswati, the deity of learning and wisdom. The name Gyanada carries the meaning “Knowledge, Wisdom” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Gyanada usually hope their child will grow to embody knowledge, wisdom and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that embodies the pursuit of knowledge and wisdom.
data.etymology: Gyanada belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Knowledge, Wisdom.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Gyanada total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
